about_the_game:
⚔️ Escape from the Underworld!
In Viking Breaker, you play as Olaf, a Viking banished to the depths of Hell. Climb aboard your drakkar, sail across rivers of lava, and smash through infernal walls with your magical shields. Fight your way through hordes of demonic creatures and challenge the guardians of Helheim, Niflheim, and a corrupted Asgard.

🛡️ Build your arsenal as you go!
During your journey, choose from powerful upgrades: shields with unique effects, specialized crew members, and devastating rune powers. Create unique combinations in every run to overcome the growing dangers of the Underworld.

🚢 Upgrade your drakkar between runs!
Between each attempt, spend your hard-earned gold to permanently enhance your drakkar. Increase its durability, speed, unlock new equipment, and prepare to venture even deeper in your next escape.

⚡ Key Features:
🪓 Fast-paced arcade gameplay, inspired by brick-breakers and bullet hell shooters.
🛡️ 10 types of shields, each with unique powers.
🔥 Magical runes to turn the tide of battle.
👹 Diverse enemies and epic bosses across 3 infernal worlds.
🚢 Roguelike progression: upgrade your drakkar and unlock new characters.
🎮 Full controller support, designed for PC and consoles.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64bit
  • Processor: x64 architecture with SSE2 instruction set support
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DX11, DX12 capable
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

short_description: Break through the walls of Hell and crush hordes of infernal creatures aboard your drakkar! Viking Breaker is an arcade roguelite mixing brick-breaker and bullet hell mechanics. Launch your shields, activate runes, and survive the trials of the Norse gods!
